feature_order_note: Band order must match exactly. All values expected in dB (log10 scale). vvChange = afterVV - beforeVV, vhChange = afterVH - beforeVH.
label_warning: Training labels are threshold-generated flood candidates derived from Sentinel-1 SAR backscatter change detection via Google Earth Engine. They are NOT independently verified flood ground truth. Do not treat model outputs as confirmed flooding.
